doc.md:
`GtkColorChooser` is an interface that is implemented by widgets
for choosing colors.

Depending on the situation, colors may be allowed to have alpha (translucency).

In GTK, the main widgets that implement this interface are
[`ColorChooserWidget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooserWidget), [`ColorChooserDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooserDialog) and
[`ColorButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorButton).

add_palette.brief: Adds a palette to the color chooser.
add_palette.md:
Adds a palette to the color chooser.

If `orientation` is horizontal, the colors are grouped in rows,
with `colors_per_line` colors in each row. If `horizontal` is `FALSE`,
the colors are grouped in columns instead.

The default color palette of [`ColorChooserWidget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooserWidget) has
45 colors, organized in columns of 5 colors (this includes some
grays).

The layout of the color chooser widget works best when the
palettes have 9-10 columns.

Calling this function for the first time has the side effect
of removing the default color palette from the color chooser.

If `colors` is `NULL`, removes all previously added palettes.

get_use_alpha.brief: Returns whether the color chooser shows the alpha channel.
get_use_alpha.md: Returns whether the color chooser shows the alpha channel.

set_use_alpha.brief: Sets whether or not the color chooser should use the alpha channel.
set_use_alpha.md: Sets whether or not the color chooser should use the alpha channel.

rgba.brief: The currently selected color, as a `GdkRGBA` struct.
rgba.deprecated_md:
Use [`ColorDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialog) and [`ColorDialogButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialogButton)
  instead of widgets implementing `GtkColorChooser`
rgba.md:
The currently selected color, as a `GdkRGBA` struct.

The property can be set to change the current selection
programmatically.

use-alpha.deprecated_md:
Use [`ColorDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialog) and [`ColorDialogButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialogButton)
  instead of widgets implementing `GtkColorChooser`
use-alpha.md:
Whether colors may have alpha (translucency).

When ::use-alpha is `FALSE`, the `GdkRGBA` struct obtained
via the [`ColorChooser:rgba`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooser#property:rgba) property will be
forced to have alpha == 1.

Implementations are expected to show alpha by rendering the color
over a non-uniform background (like a checkerboard pattern).

color-activated.brief: Emitted when a color is activated from the color chooser.
color-activated.deprecated_md:
Use [`ColorDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialog) and [`ColorDialogButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialogButton)
  instead of widgets implementing `GtkColorChooser`
color-activated.md:
Emitted when a color is activated from the color chooser.

This usually happens when the user clicks a color swatch,
or a color is selected and the user presses one of the keys
Space, Shift+Space, Return or Enter.
